title: Bumble agrees to a $1.3B acquisition deal as online dating faces a reset | TechCrunch
summary: The dating app announced Tuesday that it has agreed to a $1.3 billion acquisition deal with Ithaca Holdings, marking a major shift for a company that once looked like one of the biggest success stories in online dating.
